points.description: States that the alternative is iteration — i.e. solving the problem with an iterative (loop-based) approach instead of recursion. Accept 'iteration', 'iterative approach/method', 'using a loop', 'using a for loop / while loop', 'repeating the steps in a loop', or any equivalent wording that names iteration or looping as the alternative. Do not accept answers that only say 'without recursion' or name an unrelated technique (e.g. 'using a stack', 'dynamic programming') as the whole answer.
points.partial_credit: Half marks for a vague non-recursive approach that does not name iteration or a loop.

levels.says: Describes a non-recursive way of solving the problem (e.g. 'solve it step by step', 'use a stack to simulate the calls') but does not name iteration or a loop.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming iteration or an iterative/loop-based approach, in any wording. Half marks for a vague non-recursive approach that does not mention iteration or loops. No marks for answers that merely restate recursion or name an unrelated technique without any link to iteration.
